title: The Bell of Seven Moments
learning_focus: Sequencing at least seven events; main idea and summary; progressive tenses; adverbs of manner and time; character feelings and traits; prediction, conclusion, real-life possibility; analogy and dictionary use; formal tone; compound-complex sentences; visual purpose and stereotypes.
story_premise: The memorial bell rings seven times, but every witness remembers the order differently. A young bell keeper is blamed unfairly because of a misleading poster. The Pathfinder investigates the seven moments, corrects the record, and restores the bell’s true story.
mission_objective: Complete the three connected areas and apply the mission learning focus: Sequencing at least seven events; main idea and summary; progressive tenses; adverbs of manner and time; character feelings and traits; prediction, conclusion, real-life possibility; analogy and dictionary use; formal tone; compound-complex sentences; visual purpose and stereotypes.

areas.title: Clock Gate
areas.story: Collect seven time-stamped clues and order them. Progressive verb forms show what was happening at each moment. Read short witness statements, infer feelings and traits, and use adverbs of manner and time to distinguish observation from assumption.
